skill.name: review-animations
skill.description: Reviews interface animation and motion code for purpose, timing, easing, physicality, performance, interruptibility, accessibility, and product cohesion.
skill.summary: Delivers strict, actionable reviews of interface motion against documented animation standards.
skill.author: emilkowalski

content.value_statement: Poorly tuned motion makes interfaces feel slow, unstable, or inaccessible. This skill reviews animation code against specific standards and returns prioritized, actionable findings.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates whether motion has a clear purpose and suits interaction frequency.
Checks easing, duration, transform origin, physicality, and product cohesion.
Flags non-interruptible motion, layout animation, and avoidable main-thread work.
Reviews reduced-motion support and pointer-specific hover gating.
Returns a findings table, impact tiers, file citations, and an explicit decision.
Uses documented curves, timing ranges, spring settings, and gesture thresholds.
limitations: Reviews animation and motion code, not general application correctness.
Requires source code or a diff with enough interaction context.
Cannot confirm perceived smoothness or gesture quality without runtime observation.
Applies opinionated standards that may need documented product-specific exceptions.

use_cases.title: Review a feature before merge
use_cases.description: Assess a component diff for timing, easing, performance, interruptibility, and accessibility issues before approval.

use_cases.title: Standardize product motion
use_cases.description: Compare shared components against consistent motion rules and identify conflicting patterns across the interface.

use_cases.title: Audit accessible performance
use_cases.description: Find layout animation, reduced-motion gaps, hover issues, and gesture behavior that may degrade user experience.

prompt_templates.title: Review one animation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the animation in [file or snippet]. Identify problems with purpose, easing, duration, and reduced-motion support.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs focused feedback on one component.

prompt_templates.title: Review a component diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this component diff for motion quality. The interaction occurs [frequency] and is triggered by [input]. Cite each affected file and line.
prompt_templates.scenario: An engineer is preparing a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an interaction flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit motion across [flow]. Check frequency, physical origin, interruption, GPU usage, asymmetric timing, hover gating, and reduced-motion behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs consistent feedback across related interactions.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a motion system
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this motion system against the full standards reference. Prioritize regressions, propose exact documented values, and finish with a block or approve decision.
prompt_templates.scenario: A design system owner needs a detailed standards review.

output_examples.input: Review a dropdown that enters slowly from its center and lacks reduced-motion handling.
output_examples.output: Block. The findings identify sluggish entry easing, an incorrect transform origin, excessive duration, and missing reduced-motion behavior.

output_examples.input: Review a toast stack implemented with keyframes and parent-driven style variables.
output_examples.output: Block. The review prioritizes interruption failures and style recalculation risk, then recommends transitions and direct element transforms.

output_examples.input: Review a short popover transition with trigger-aware origin and accessible motion settings.
output_examples.output: Approve. The review confirms responsive timing, correct physical origin, bounded properties, and appropriate reduced-motion behavior.

best_practices: Provide the changed files, relevant lines, and surrounding component context.
State interaction frequency, trigger type, and intended product personality.
Include reduced-motion branches, gesture states, and performance-sensitive conditions.
anti_patterns: Do not request a general code review unrelated to animation or motion.
Do not provide isolated timing values without the component and interaction context.
Do not assume every interface element should animate or share identical motion.

faq.question: What code does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews CSS, JavaScript, and component motion patterns that affect interface animation behavior.

faq.question: Does it fix the code automatically?
faq.answer: It proposes specific changes and documented values, but its primary task is review.

faq.question: Does it review general application logic?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on animation and motion code, not unrelated correctness or architecture.

faq.question: How does it address accessibility?
faq.answer: It checks reduced-motion behavior and ensures hover motion targets devices with suitable pointer capabilities.

faq.question: Can it assess performance risks?
faq.answer: Yes. It flags layout animation, style recalculation patterns, and motion likely to burden the main thread.

faq.question: What information improves the review?
faq.answer: Provide the diff, file context, trigger method, usage frequency, target devices, and product motion goals.
